name: Apple TV

fastest.text: On iPhone: Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Apple TV → Cancel Subscription. On the web, use Apple's subscriptions page.

steps: Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad and tap your name.
Tap Cancel Subscription (you may need to scroll down).
note: Getting Apple TV through Apple One? Then you cancel Apple One or switch to an Apple One plan without it.

faq.q: Can I cancel on the web?
faq.a: Yes. Sign in with your Apple Account on Apple's subscriptions page and follow the prompts.

faq.q: I don't see a Cancel button. Why?
faq.a: If there's no Cancel button, or you see an expiration message in red, the subscription is already cancelled.
You can ask Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com: sign in, choose I'd like to → Request a refund, pick the subscription and submit. Apple usually answers within 24 to 48 hours.
Paying yearly, at $119/yr, costs less than twelve monthly payments of $14.99.
